feature: Unattended budget waiting now ends at the task total deadline instead of parking forever

changes.journal: expire(identity, now) sweeps waiting-budget tasks whose deadline_ms<=now to failed with BUDGET_WAIT_EXPIRED and records a budget-wait-expired event inside one fenced transaction
changes.service: The runner sweep runs on start and on every heartbeat renewal (runnerTtlMs/3); no new timer or scheduler is introduced
changes.semantics: Explicit retry and cancel keep their existing behavior; retry after expiry still refuses with TASK_DEADLINE because a retry cannot extend the total deadline

newChecks: Journal: budget waiting survives a sweep before the deadline, expires at it with one failed attempt, a budget-wait-expired event and no new attempt, and retry still refuses with TASK_DEADLINE
Service: unattended budget waiting expires through the runner heartbeat sweep with zero extra backend calls and no replay

remoteMachineEvidence: Ubuntu and Win10 re-runs of the enlarged task suite are pending; this checkpoint was produced on the local Win11 machine only
limitations: Waiting-budget auto-expiry covers the journal deadline; the product UI for waiting and expired budget states reuses the existing task card labels and has no dedicated acceptance yet
Initial Task/outbox and funding admission remain separate transactions; this change does not make them one
Missing-receipt manual reconciliation UI and budget-wait product notifications are still not implemented
